news.headline: Congress releases video of Rahul Gandhi entering Akashwani Bhawan during INDIA bloc protest march
news.story_lead: The Indian National Congress shared a video showing Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi entering the Akashwani Bhawan complex during an INDIA bloc march towards the Election Commission of India office. Security barriers prompted opposition leaders to stage a sit-in protest within the premises after police blocked their designated routes.
news.full_article_text:
The Indian National Congress released a video documenting party MP and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, entering the Akashwani Bhawan complex during a protest march toward the Election Commission of India (ECI) office. The footage captured the Congress leader accessing the complex, situated approximately 100 metres from the poll body office, despite security personnel closing the main gates. According to reports, Rahul Gandhi caught fellow opposition MPs by surprise when he spoke to his sister, Priyanka Gandhi, and dashed towards the reception entrance of Akashwani Bhawan, the headquarters of All India Radio (AIR).

Security officials had previously closed three key routes leading to the ECI office: Sansad Marg, Kundan Lal Sehgal Road, and Mahadev Road. However, Rahul Gandhi utilized the Akashvani Bhawan premises, whose rear gate opens directly in front of the ECI office. Accompanied by Congress leaders Priyanka Gandhi, KC Venugopal, and others, he entered the complex and staged an extended sit-in protest that continued past sunset. Rahul Gandhi stated his objective was to meet the Chief Election Commissioner to register grievances regarding the electoral process, noting he was comfortable continuing the sit-in if alternative sites were not provided.

Earlier in the day, over 300 opposition MPs had marched from Parliament to meet election authorities. During the march, police stopped protesters midway, prompting Rahul Gandhi, TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee, and Priyanka Gandhi to climb atop police barricades while waving the Tricolour and raising slogans. Several opposition leaders, including Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, TMC MPs Abhishek Banerjee and Derek O'Brien, and CPI(M) MP John Brittas, were briefly detained by police before being released later. Meanwhile, Election Commission officials stated they had not received any formal meeting request from any political party regarding the event.
bullet_points: The Indian National Congress shared a video capturing Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi entering the Akashwani Bhawan complex during an INDIA bloc protest march.
Akashwani Bhawan, the headquarters of All India Radio, is located approximately 100 metres away from the Election Commission of India office.
Security officials had blocked three major routes to the ECI office, namely Sansad Marg, Kundan Lal Sehgal Road, and Mahadev Road.

Election Commission officials maintained that they had not received any formal meeting request from any political party for the delegation.

news.headline: Madhya Pradesh Islamic Body Advises Muslim Youth Against Attending Garba Events for Social Media Content
news.story_lead: The Madhya Pradesh Muslim Tyohar Committee has issued an appeal urging Muslim youth and students to refrain from attending Garba events solely to create social media reels, likes, and views. The committee stated that the advisory aims to prevent the wider community from being defamed or targeted politically.
news.full_article_text: The Madhya Pradesh Muslim Tyohar Committee released an advisory on Tuesday requesting Muslim youth and students to avoid participating in Garba events just for social media content such as reels, likes, and views. According to Zeeshan Rehman, the state president of the committee, these celebrations are neither religious festivals nor programs associated with the Muslim community. Rehman noted that individual actions during such events can lead to the entire community facing consequences and negative reputations. The committee formally wrote to relevant administrative and Madhya Pradesh government authorities, asking them to disseminate the appeal across universities, colleges, technical institutions, medical colleges, and hostels prior to October 11. Additionally, the advisory urged young Muslims to respect the beliefs and traditions of all faiths, obey local laws and regulations, avoid conflicts, provocations, and inappropriate reactions, and refrain from attending religious events purely for online traction. Rehman explained that the guidance was prompted by recurring political targeting of Muslims over allegations of participating in Garba gatherings under hidden identities or attempting to cause religious incitement and 'love jihad'. The committee emphasized that its statement is not directed against any religion or the celebration of Garba itself, but rather seeks to encourage responsible conduct, adherence to legal norms, and social harmony.

Committee state president Zeeshan Rehman stated that Garba celebrations are not Muslim community festivals, and individual actions can bring disrepute to the entire community.

The committee submitted letters to administrative and state government officials to circulate the advisory among universities, colleges, medical and technical institutions, and hostels before October 11.
Young Muslims were advised to respect all religious traditions, adhere to local laws, and avoid disputes and provocative behavior.
Rehman highlighted that the advisory was a response to political targeting and allegations regarding Muslims attending Garba events under hidden identities.
The organization clarified that the appeal does not oppose Garba celebrations or any religion, but aims to foster social harmony and responsible behavior.

hindi_translation.story_lead: मध्य प्रदेश मुस्लिम त्योहार समिति ने मुस्लिम युवाओं और छात्रों से केवल सोशल मीडिया रील्स, लाइक्स और व्यूज के लिए गरबा कार्यक्रमों में शामिल होने से बचने की अपील की है। समिति ने कहा कि इस तरह के कदमों से समुदाय की प्रतिष्ठा प्रभावित हो सकती है।

news.headline: Election Commission states no party sought meeting prior to 4 pm during INDIA bloc protest
news.story_lead: The Election Commission of India stated that no political party formally requested an appointment before 4 pm on Tuesday amidst an escalation of protests by the INDIA bloc over electoral roll issues. Opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi marched from Parliament to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar before being stopped by police.
news.full_article_text:
The Election Commission of India (ECI) announced on Tuesday that no political party had formally submitted a request for an appointment before 4 pm. This clarification came as protests by the INDIA opposition bloc intensified in New Delhi over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and the handling of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.

Earlier in the day, Opposition MPs, headed by Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi, marched from Parliament towards the ECI headquarters at Nirvachan Sadan. Their stated objectives were to demand a meeting with the poll panel and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Security forces intercepted the march near the NITI Aayog-Akashvani Bhawan stretch, prompting the leaders and accompanying MPs to stage a sit-in demonstration.

In an official press release issued later that day, the ECI clarified that it was informed by Delhi Police at approximately 4 pm that a delegation of MPs led by Rahul Gandhi wanted to meet the Commission to submit a memorandum. The poll panel noted that it maintains an established procedure established in 2025 requiring political parties to seek appointments through authorised representatives for meetings held at mutually agreed times at the Commission's premises.

According to the ECI, the Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) subsequently conveyed that the proposed meeting involved roughly 240 MPs and was intended to take place at the Parliament House Annexe. The Commission deemed this request unusual and declined it due to its protocol requiring such delegations to visit the ECI premises. However, the poll panel offered an unprecedented alternative by proposing to send its most senior serving officer to the Parliament Annexe to receive the memorandum, a proposal which the MPs declined.

The INDIA bloc's march followed a resolution from an Opposition meeting held on September 30 to protest against the functioning of the poll panel and the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Prominent leaders participating in the demonstration included Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. During the protests, Rahul Gandhi climbed a police barricade holding the Tricolour. Following a prolonged sit-in lasting nearly nine hours, Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and approximately 250 other individuals and MPs were detained by Delhi Police and removed from the site in a bus.
news.background_context: The Opposition protest stems from a decision made during an Opposition parties meeting on September 30 regarding concerns over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and the functioning of the poll panel.

The ECI declined the Parliament Annexe venue citing protocol, but offered to send its senior-most officer to receive the memorandum, which the MPs declined.
Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, along with around 250 other protesters and MPs, were detained by Delhi Police after a nearly nine-hour sit-in.

news.headline: Election Commission Rejects Meeting with INDIA Bloc MPs Citing Protocol Violations
news.story_lead: The Election Commission of India (ECI) declined a meeting request from over 300 Opposition MPs belonging to the INDIA bloc who marched from the Parliament Complex. The poll body cited protocol violations, stating that the proposed gathering of 240 MPs at the Parliament Annexe was unusual and unacceptable.
news.full_article_text:
The Election Commission of India (ECI) rejected a meeting proposal with opposition parliamentarians, labeling their demands as unusual and unacceptable. The poll body stated that it received no prior appointment request directly from any political party, and only learned about the proposed interaction through the Delhi Police around 4 pm on Tuesday. The development unfolded as more than 300 Opposition MPs of the INDIA bloc marched from the Parliament Complex toward the Election Commission office to submit a formal memorandum.

Declining the request on grounds of established administrative protocol, the ECI emphasized that political parties must follow a specific framework established in 2015 for meetings with the Commission. Under this protocol, delegations or single parties must request appointments through their duly authorized representatives, and meetings are scheduled at mutually convenient times. Furthermore, the ECI objected to the venue and scale, noting that the Deputy Commissioner of Police informed them that 240 Opposition MPs would gather at the Parliament Annexe. The poll body maintained that such interactions must occur inside Election Commission premises. Although the ECI offered to send its most senior serving official to the meeting venue to receive the memorandum—a step the poll body described as unprecedented—the INDIA bloc MPs rejected the proposal.

news.headline: Magnitude 4.9 Earthquake Strikes Uttarakhand's Chamoli With Tremors Felt in Delhi-NCR
news.story_lead: An earthquake measuring 4.9 on the Richter scale struck the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand, sending tremors as far as the Delhi-NCR region. The National Centre for Seismology reported multiple seismic activities across different regions of India over a span of days.
news.full_article_text:
A magnitude 4.9 earthquake occurred in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand, according to data from the National Centre for Seismology (NCS). The seismic event took place at 22:23:23 pm IST at a depth of 13 kilometres, with its epicenter situated 50 kilometres south of Joshimath. The tremors resulting from this earthquake were felt across the Delhi-NCR region.

In addition to the Uttarakhand event, the NCS reported other seismic occurrences across the country. Earlier on the same day, an earthquake of magnitude 4.5 struck Assam’s Nagaon district at 4:23:47 am IST. This tremor occurred at a depth of 33 kilometres, with its epicenter located at latitude 26.428 North and longitude 93.060 East.

Furthermore, on October 5, Himachal Pradesh's Una district experienced an earthquake measuring 2.5 on the Richter scale late on Sunday night. Recorded at 23:48:35 IST, this minor tremor had a shallow depth of 9 kilometres and was centered at latitude 31.618 North and longitude 76.301 East.

नेशनल सेंटर फॉर सीमोलॉजी (NCS) के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, उत्तराखंड के चमोली जिले में 4.9 तीव्रता का भूकंप आया। यह भूकंपीय घटना रात 22:23:23 बजे 13 किलोमीटर की गहराई पर हुई, जिसका अधिकेंद्र जोशीमठ, उत्तराखंड से 50 किलोमीटर दक्षिण में स्थित था। इस भूकंप के झटके दिल्ली-एनसीआर क्षेत्र में महसूस किए गए।

उत्तराखंड की घटना के अलावा, NCS ने देश भर में अन्य भूकंपीय गतिविधियों की भी सूचना दी। इसी दिन की शुरुआत में, सुबह 4:23:47 बजे असम के नगांव जिले में 4.5 तीव्रता का भूकंप आया। यह भूकंप 33 किलोमीटर की गहराई पर हुआ, जिसका अधिकेंद्र उत्तरी अक्षांश 26.428 और पूर्वी देशांतर 93.060 पर स्थित था।

इसके अलावा, 5 अक्टूबर को हिमाचल प्रदेश के ऊना जिले में रविवार देर रात रिक्टर स्केल पर 2.5 तीव्रता का भूकंप आया। NCS के अनुसार, ये झटके भारतीय समनुसार रात 23:48:35 बजे महसूस किए गए। इसका अधिकेंद्र 9 किलोमीटर की उथली गहराई पर उत्तरी अक्षांश 31.618 और पूर्वी देशांतर 76.301 पर स्थित था।

news.headline: CBI Registers FIR Against Punjab CM's OSD and Five Others Following High Court and ED Directives
news.story_lead: The Central Bureau of Investigation has launched a corruption probe by filing an FIR against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, Officer on Special Duty to Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, and five other individuals. The investigation follows orders from the Punjab and Haryana High Court based on findings from the Enforcement Directorate.
news.full_article_text:
The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has initiated a formal corruption inquiry by filing an FIR against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, Officer on Special Duty (OSD) to Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, along with five other named individuals and unknown public or private persons. As part of this corruption probe, the central agency executed coordinated searches across eight locations, including the Punjab Chief Minister's camp office in Chandigarh and the residence of the OSD. During these operations, investigators recovered and seized incriminating items such as laptops, mobile phones, and documents to examine potential evidence of bribery and other forms of administrative misconduct. The extensive searches spanned multiple cities and towns, covering Chandigarh, Mohali, Gurdaspur, Ludhiana, Patiala, Sangrur, and Jalandhar.

Apart from the OSD, the newly filed FIR names Nitin Gohal, Jitin Gohal alias Raja, Romi Raja Mahajan, Bir Devinder, and RS Nagra. According to the CBI, the accused individuals allegedly used their influence to manipulate official postings of bureaucrats, including senior IAS and IPS officers. They are also accused of meddling in departmental proceedings, administrative policy formulations, government approvals, tender conditions, licensing regulations, land-use conversions, property disputes, and broader revenue and land-related matters in exchange for financial gains. Furthermore, the agency has accused public servants involved in the nexus of leaking confidential drafts of government orders and policies to private persons before official issuance.

The case stems from allegations of high-level corruption within the Punjab administration uncovered by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). Following a public interest litigation (PIL) filed by advocate Nikhil Saraf and subsequent hearings, the Punjab and Haryana High Court directed the CBI to take over the investigation and examine the materials presented by the ED. The court specifically noted concerns regarding why the OSD was omitted from the Punjab Police's initial preliminary inquiries despite being prominently named in the ED's investigative material. Meanwhile, the Punjab government has contested the High Court's order by approaching the Supreme Court, and legal proceedings are scheduled to continue later in the week.

hindi_translation.headline: सीबीआई ने पंजाब के सीएम भगवंत मान के ओएसडी और 5 अन्य के खिलाफ दर्ज की एफआईआर
hindi_translation.story_lead: केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (सीबीआई) ने पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान के विशेष कर्तव्य अधिकारी (ओएसडी) राजबीर सिंह घुम्मन और पांच अन्य लोगों के खिलाफ भ्रष्टाचार के आरोपों में एफआईआर दर्ज कर ली है। यह जांच पंजाब और हरियाणा उच्च न्यायालय के आदेश और प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) की रिपोर्ट के आधार पर शुरू की गई है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (सीबीआई) ने भ्रष्टाचार की जांच के सिलसिले में चंडीगढ़ में पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान के कैंप कार्यालय और उनके ओएसडी राजबीर सिंह घुम्मन के आवास सहित आठ ठिकानों पर तलाशी ली है। एजेंसी ने बताया कि तलाशी के दौरान लैपटॉप, मोबाइल फोन और दस्तावेजों जैसी आपत्तिजनक सामग्री जब्त की गई है, जिसकी रिश्वतखोरी और अन्य अनियमितताओं के साक्ष्यों के लिए जांच की जा रही है। सीबीआई के अनुसार, चंडीगढ़, मोहाली, गुरदासपुर, लुधियाना, पटियाला, संगरूर और जालंधर में आरोपियों से जुड़े परिसरों पर व्यापक और समन्वित छापे मारे गए।

एफ़आईआर में ओएसडी घुम्मन के अलावा नितिन गोहाल, जitin गोहाल उर्फ राजा, रोमी राजा महाजन, बीर देवेंद्र और आरएस नागरा तथा अज्ञात लोक सेवकों और निजी व्यक्तियों के नाम शामिल हैं। सीबीआई ने कहा कि उसने मुख्यमंत्री के ओएसडी और उनके सहयोगियों के खिलाफ भ्रष्टाचार के आरोपों की जांच के लिए एफआईआर दर्ज की है। आरोप है कि आरोपियों ने आर्थिक लाभ के एवज में आईएएस और आईपीएस अधिकारियों सहित अधिकारियों के तबादलों, विभागीय कार्यवाही, नीतिगत निर्णयों, प्रशासनिक स्वीकृतियों, टेंडर शर्तों, लाइसेंसिंग मामलों, भूमि उपयोग परिवर्तन, संपत्ति विवादों और राजस्व से जुड़े मामलों को प्रभावित और हेरफेर किया।

एजेंसी ने यह भी आरोप लगाया कि आरोपी लोक सेवकों ने सरकारी आदेशों और नीतियों के मसौदे सरकार द्वारा आधिकारिक रूप से जारी किए जाने से पहले निजी व्यक्तियों तक पहुंचाए थे। इस मामले की पृष्ठभूमि प्रवर्तन निदेशालय द्वारा पंजाब सरकार में उच्च स्तर पर भ्रष्टाचार के आरोपों से जुड़ी है, जिसे उच्च न्यायालय ने संज्ञान में लेते हुए सीबीआई को जांच का आदेश दिया था। पंजाब सरकार ने उच्च न्यायालय के इस आदेश के खिलाफ सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का रुख किया है।

छापेमारी के दौरान लैपटॉप, मोबाइल फोन और महत्वपूर्ण दस्तावेज जब्त किए गए।
आरोपियों पर अधिकारियों के तबादलों, टेंडर और नीतियों में हेरफेर कर वित्तीय लाभ कमाने का आरोप है।

news.headline: Delhi Traffic Restrictions Imposed for BJP Event Marking Prime Minister's 25 Years in Public Life
news.story_lead: The Delhi Traffic Police have announced movement curbs and diversions across several key routes in the national capital on Wednesday. The restrictions are being implemented to facilitate the 'Seva Jyoti' programme organized by the Delhi BJP at the Indira Gandhi Stadium Complex to mark 25 years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi in public life.
news.full_article_text:
Extensive traffic restrictions and diversions will come into force in New Delhi on Wednesday as the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) celebrates 25 years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi in public life. The main event, titled the 'Seva Jyoti' programme, is scheduled to take place at the Indira Gandhi Stadium Complex. Ahead of the event, processions comprising party workers and supporters from organizational mandals across Delhi will converge at the venue.

According to the traffic advisory issued by the authorities, strict curbs will be operational from 5 am to 1 pm around the venue and surrounding corridors. Additionally, no traffic will be permitted on Secretariat Road and Velodrome Road starting from 6 am onwards based on operational requirements. Motorists have been advised to avoid several major arteries, including Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, JLN Marg, Mahatma Gandhi Marg (Ring Road), IP Marg, Vikas Marg, and the Salimgarh Bypass.

Specific road stretches facing traffic diversions include the Shanti Van Crossing-Rajghat-Bhairon Marg route on both carriageways of Ring Road, the stretch between Geeta Colony Flyover, IP Flyover, and Salimgarh Bypass, as well as W-Point-Delhi Gate and Delhi Gate-Rajghat on JLN Marg. The advisory also affects the Rajghat-Kisan Ghat/Power House Road stretch and both carriageways connecting ITO and the Yamuna Bridge via IP Marg and Vikas Marg.

Authorities have stated that parking will be strictly prohibited along all affected routes and stretches. Vehicles found parked in these restricted zones will be towed away, and owners will face prosecution. Prominent figures, including Delhi BJP president Harsh Malhotra, Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, along with various MPs, MLAs, and national and state office-bearers, are anticipated to participate in the celebrations.

hindi_translation.headline: दिल्ली ट्रैफिक अपडेट: पीएम मोदी के सार्वजनिक जीवन के 25 साल पूरे होने पर बीजेपी के कार्यक्रम के कारण 7 अक्टूबर को प्रतिबंध; प्रभावित मार्ग और समय देखें
hindi_translation.story_lead: दिल्ली ट्रैफिक पुलिस ने बुधवार को राष्ट्रीय राजधानी के कई प्रमुख मार्गों पर यातायात प्रतिबंधों और डायवर्जन की घोषणा की है। ये प्रतिबंध प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के सार्वजनिक जीवन में 25 वर्ष पूरे होने के उपलक्ष्य में दिल्ली भाजपा द्वारा इंदिरा गांधी स्टेडियम कॉम्प्लेक्स में आयोजित 'सेवा ज्योति' कार्यक्रम को सुचारू रूप से संपन्न कराने के लिए लगाए जा रहे हैं।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के सार्वजनिक जीवन के 25 वर्ष पूरे होने का जश्न मनाने के साथ ही बुधवार को नई दिल्ली में व्यापक यातायात प्रतिबंध और डायवर्जन लागू हो जाएंगे। मुख्य कार्यक्रम, जिसका शीर्षक 'सेवा ज्योति' है, इंदिरा गांधी स्टेडियम कॉम्प्लेक्स में आयोजित किया जाना है। इस कार्यक्रम से पहले दिल्ली भर के संगठनात्मक मंडलों से भाजपा कार्यकर्ताओं और समर्थकों के जुलूस स्थल पर एकत्र होंगे।

याचता और परिचालन आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार, प्रतिबंध सुबह 5 बजे से दोपहर 1 बजे तक इंदिरा गांधी स्टेडियम कॉम्प्लेक्स के आसपास प्रभावी रहेंगे। पुलिस के अनुसार, परिचालन आवश्यकताओं के तहत सुबह 6 बजे से सचिवालय रोड और वेलोड्रोम रोड पर किसी भी यातायात की अनुमति नहीं होगी। मोटर चालकों को बहादुर शाह जफर मार्ग, जेएलएन मार्ग, महात्मा गांधी मार्ग (रिंग रोड), आईपी मार्ग, विकास मार्ग और सलेमगढ़ बाईपास सहित कई प्रमुख मार्गों से बचने की सलाह दी गई है।

प्रभावित होने वाले विशिष्ट सड़क खंडों में शांति वन क्रॉसिंग-राजघाट-भैरों मार्ग (रिंग रोड के दोनों कैरिजवे), गीता कॉलोनी फ्लाईओवर, आईपी फ्लाईओवर और सलेमगढ़ बाईपास के बीच का हिस्सा, डब्ल्यू-पॉइंट-दिल्ली गेट और जेएलएन मार्ग पर दिल्ली गेट-राजघाट शामिल हैं। सलाह के अनुसार राजघाट-किसान घाट/पावर हाउस रोड खंड और आईपी मार्ग तथा विकास मार्ग के माध्यम से आईटीओ और यमुना ब्रिज के बीच के दोनों कैरिजवे भी प्रभावित रहेंगे।

यातायात पुलिस ने यात्रियों को सुबह 5 बजे से दोपहर 1 बजे के बीच इन मार्गों से बचने की सलाह दी है। इसके अलावा प्रभावित सड़कों पर पार्किंग पूरी तरह प्रतिबंधित रहेगी और नियमों का उल्लंघन करने वाले वाहनों को टो किया जा सकता है।
bullet_points: बुधवार को सुबह 5 बजे से दोपहर 1 बजे तक इंदिरा गांधी स्टेडियम कॉम्प्लेक्स के आसपास यातायात प्रतिबंध लागू रहेंगे।
यह प्रतिबंध पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी के सार्वजनिक जीवन के 25 वर्ष पूरे होने पर दिल्ली भाजपा के 'सेवा ज्योति' कार्यक्रम के कारण हैं।
सुबह 6 बजे से सचिवालय रोड और वेलोड्रोम रोड पर यातायात की अनुमति नहीं होगी।
बहादुर शाह जफर मार्ग, जेएलएन मार्ग, रिंग रोड, आईपी मार्ग, विकास मार्ग और सलेमगढ़ बाईपास पर यातायात प्रभावित रहेगा।
प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में वाहनों की पार्किंग प्रतिबंधित है और उल्लंघन करने पर वाहन टो किए जाएंगे।

news.headline: Dentist Shota Musaev recounts 45-minute effort to save Indian pilot Smit Machchhar after mid-air attack
news.story_lead: Dentist Shota Musaev has detailed his 45-minute medical intervention to save Indian captain Smit Machchhar, who suffered severe head and hand injuries after being stabbed by his co-pilot on a flydubai flight to Tel Aviv. The incident, which UAE officials termed a terrorist attack, involved the pilot fighting off the co-pilot before opening the cockpit door to alert passengers.
news.full_article_text: Dentist Shota Musaev has recounted the critical 45-minute period during which he attempted to save Indian Captain Smit Machchhar on a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Machchhar was bleeding profusely from his head and left hand after being stabbed by his co-pilot, identified as Omani national Hammam al-Hammami, in what a UAE official later termed a terrorist attack. Dr Musaev used T-shirts and ice packs to maintain pressure on the deep wounds while engaging the pilot in conversation to keep him conscious. At one point, Machchhar's pulse dropped significantly and his lips turned blue, prompting the dentist to elevate the pilot's feet to restore his pulse and urge the flight crew to land quickly. Machchhar had managed to open the cockpit door despite his injuries, allowing passengers to rush in and pin down the attacker. Following the incident, Machchhar interacted via video call with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, stating he remained determined to prevent the aircraft from going down despite collapsing from his wounds.
bullet_points: Dentist Shota Musaev spent 45 minutes treating Indian Captain Smit Machchhar on board flydubai flight FZ1073.
Machchhar suffered severe head and left-hand injuries from stab wounds inflicted by his co-pilot.
The co-pilot was identified as Hammam al-Hammami, an Omani national, in an incident termed a terrorist attack by UAE officials.
Dr Musaev used T-shirts, ice packets, and leg elevation to stabilize Machchhar when his pulse dropped and lips turned blue.
Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door, enabling passengers to overpower and pin down the attacker.
The injured pilot later received a video call from Prime Minister Narendra Modi, where Machchhar recounted his resolve to save the passengers.

The flight number was FZ1073 traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv.

hindi_translation.headline: डेंटिस्ट शोटा मुसाएव ने भारतीय पायलट स्मित मच्छहर की जान बचाने के लिए 45 मिनट के संघर्ष को याद किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: डेंटिस्ट शोटा मुसाएव ने तेल अवीव जाने वाली फ्लाईदुबई उड़ान के दौरान सह-पायलट द्वारा चाकू से हमला किए जाने के बाद गंभीर रूप से घायल भारतीय कैप्टन स्मित मच्छहर की जान बचाने के लिए किए गए 45 मिनट के प्रयासों का विवरण दिया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: डेंटिस्ट शोटा मुसाएव ने दुबई से तेल अवीव जा रही फ्लाईदुबई उड़ान के दौरान भारतीय कैप्टन स्मित मच्छहर को बचाने के अपने 45 मिनट के संघर्ष को साझा किया है। मच्छहर के सिर और बाएं हाथ से भारी खून बह रहा था, जब ओमान के सह-पायलट हम्माम अल-हम्मामी ने उन पर हमला किया था। यूएई के अधिकारियों ने इस घटना को आतंकवादी हमला बताया है। डॉ. मुसाएव ने घावों पर दबाव बनाए रखने के लिए टी-शर्ट और बर्फ की थैलियों का इस्तेमाल किया और पायलट को होश में रखने के लिए बातचीत की।
bullet_points: डेंटिस्ट शोटा मुसाएव ने फ्लाईदुबई उड़ान FZ1073 पर भारतीय कैप्टन स्मित मच्छहर का 45 मिनट तक इलाज किया।
सह-पायलट द्वारा किए गए हमले में मच्छहर के सिर और हाथ में गंभीर चोटें आईं।
हमलावर ओमान का नागरिक हम्माम अल-हम्मामी था जिसे यूएई ने आतंकवादी हमला करार दिया।
पायलट की जान बचाने के लिए प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने वीडियो कॉल के जरिए उनसे बात की।
key_facts: कैप्टन स्मित मच्छहर एक भारतीय पायलट हैं जिन्होंने फ्लाईदुबई उड़ान में कॉकपिट हमले को नाकाम किया।
